name: Dongfeng Mengshi (CSK-131 / CSK-181)
armament: 12.7 mm QJZ-89 HMG or 35 mm QLZ-87 AGL on roof ring/RWS
HJ-12 / HJ-10 ATGM on some variants
protection: CSK-131 light armoured version, CSK-181 third-generation protected vehicle with V-shaped belly. Game: immune to small-calibre rounds (5.45/5.56/5.8/7.62x39/7.62x51 ball); 7.62x54R and larger penetrate side/rear and disable tyres and engine; any launcher destroys it.
visual_notes: Humvee-like wide 4x4 with flat bonnet and large grille (first generation), boxier armoured cab on CSK-131/181
CSK-181: higher V-hull, armoured doors with small windows, roof hatch with gun shield
Spare wheel on the rear, often slatted cargo racks
Ubiquitous PLA and PAP utility/patrol vehicle
